contents_summary: Three-page PDF in the ZIP: Table S1, vHIT results before surgery and at one month, three months and one year after surgery for Patients 1 to 4. Each patient block gives age, first symptom, tumor side, MRI tumor size and surgical approach, then per-canal (lateral, anterior, posterior, SHIMP) saccade descriptions and, for lateral and SHIMP, gain values for the tumor side and the healthy side. All three pages were rendered and viewed.

pages.contents: Page 1: title of Table S1 and the first part of the table. PATIENT #1 block with a header row (age, first symptom, tumor side, tumor size in MRI, surgical approach), a time row (before surgery, 1 month, 3 months, 1 year after surgery) and tumor-side and healthy-side rows for LATERAL, ANTERIOR, POSTERIOR and SHIMP; PATIENT #2 header, time row, the tumor-side block and the first (LATERAL) row of the healthy side. Cells hold saccade descriptions and gain values with decimal commas.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Patient-numbered vHIT results for Patients 1 and 2, with the owner printed in each PATIENT # banner.
limitations: No printed rights notice or exception on the page; the footer carries a placeholder journal line. Article source license retained without blanket relicensing.
Patient 2 healthy-side LATERAL row continues on page 2: its page-1 cells show the saccade descriptions and the antisaccades/gain lines are printed at the top of page 2.

pages.contents: Page 2: continuation of the Patient 2 healthy-side LATERAL row (antisaccades and gain lines), ANTERIOR, POSTERIOR and SHIMP rows; the full PATIENT #3 block; and PATIENT #4 header, time row and tumor-side block, ending with the HEALTHY SIDE banner.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Patient-numbered vHIT results for Patients 2, 3 and 4.
limitations: No printed rights notice or exception on the page.
Patient 4 healthy-side rows are on page 3.

pages.contents: Page 3: Patient 4 healthy-side LATERAL, ANTERIOR, POSTERIOR and SHIMP rows, and the footnote "SCC-semicircular canal."
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Patient 4 healthy-side vHIT results; the owner is the PATIENT #4 banner on page 2, continued under the table.
limitations: The PATIENT #4 banner is on page 2; page 3 continues that table without repeating it.
No printed rights notice or exception on the page.
Table S1 is transcribed from the rendered pages; decimal commas are kept as printed and read as decimal points only in numeric_value.
Words hyphenated across lines in the cells (artifacts, tifacts) are joined; cell text split across two lines is joined with a space.
The abbreviations MFA and TL are not expanded in the table.
No normal or abnormal flags were assigned from the reference range stated in the article Methods.
